# AutoAcre

> AutoAcre is an RTK + LiDAR autonomous mowing systems provider for 3–10 acre acreage properties across the Northern Rivers, NSW. Buy + Manage offer: customers buy the autonomous mowing system outright (reference $33,490) and AutoAcre manages it under a tiered $165–$650/month fee. Service operations begin Q1 2027; site assessments and the ROI calculator are open today. The ROI Calculator (https://autoacre.com.au/robot-mower-roi-calculator.html) is the primary decision tool.

AutoAcre supplies and operates RTK + LiDAR autonomous mowing systems engineered for the Northern Rivers acreage market. Founded and operated by Ben Bonifant in Byron Bay, AutoAcre installs commercial-grade autonomous mowers — RTK base station, LiDAR obstacle avoidance, 38° slope handling, 25-acre daily capacity per unit — under a Buy + Manage offer where the customer owns the asset and AutoAcre runs the ongoing service. Service operations begin Q1 2027. The site is built around decision support: an ROI calculator, an Acreage Solutions hub, and tier-by-tier property profiles help property owners decide whether autonomous mowing makes sense for their block before committing.

Key facts:
- Position: RTK + LiDAR autonomous mowing systems provider for 3–10 acre Northern Rivers acreage; technology-led, premium, residential-acreage-focused.
- Launch: service operations begin Q1 2027; ROI calculator and site assessments are open today.
- Service area: Northern Rivers, NSW (Byron Shire and Ballina Shire — Byron Bay, Bangalow, Newrybar, Ewingsdale, Mullumbimby, Federal, Myocum, Tyagarah, Brooklet, Clunes, Eureka, Nashua, Teven, Tintenbar, Alstonville).
- Equipment: commercial-grade RTK + LiDAR autonomous robotic mowers (typically 25-acre daily capacity, up to 38° slope handling, 2 cm RTK positioning accuracy). Specific platform recommended per property — PANDAG G1, Husqvarna CEORA, Mammotion Luba 2 AWD or Echo TM-2050 depending on terrain and slope.
- Buy + Manage offer: autonomous mowing system reference price $33,490 (final price varies by manufacturer selection) + tiered monthly management fee from $195/month at 3 acres to $650/month at 10 acres. Ad-hoc on-site call-outs $150/visit.
- Mowing cadence: twice-weekly in summer, weekly in winter (~78 mow days/year) — about 3× a fortnightly contractor.
- Property size: 3–10 acres residential; commercial deployments at 10+ acres scoped per site.
- Reliability: scheduled maintenance, blade replacements, firmware updates, remote monitoring and repair coordination all included in the management service.
- Contract: management service month-to-month with 30 days notice, no lock-in; mower owned outright by customer.
- Founder: Ben Bonifant, Byron Bay, NSW.
- Phone: 0499 649 094 / +61 499 649 094.
- Email: ben@autoacre.com.au.

- [3–10 acre Autonomous Systems](https://autoacre.com.au/3-10-acre-autonomous-mowing-systems.html): Property-fit deep dive — tier-by-tier profiles at 3, 5, 7 and 10 acres covering install reality, pricing, and 8-year economics at each acreage tier.
- [RTK Robot Mower Installation](https://autoacre.com.au/rtk-robot-mower-installation.html): Technology and installation deep dive — what RTK is, how it works, the install process step by step, base station mounting, long-term accuracy.
- [Commercial deployments](https://autoacre.com.au/commercial.html): Commercial autonomous mowing for sites beyond 10 acres — councils, schools, resorts, golf courses, solar farms, orchards, equine and large estates. Equipment supply or fully-managed deployment.

- [ROI Calculator](https://autoacre.com.au/robot-mower-roi-calculator.html): The primary decision tool. Compares your current contractor cost against autonomous mowing across an 8-year window. Honest assumptions published.
- [Book Site Assessment](https://autoacre.com.au/book-site-assessment.html): Conversion form. Two-minute online start, on-site visit when scheduled. Honest property-fit assessment with fixed reference pricing.

## Comparisons

- [Best robot mower for large properties](https://autoacre.com.au/best-robot-mower-for-large-properties.html): Honest comparison of the four commercial-grade platforms (PANDAG G1, Husqvarna CEORA, Mammotion Luba 2 AWD, Echo TM-2050) for 3–10 acre acreage. Where each wins, where each falls short, how to decide.
- [RTK vs boundary wire](https://autoacre.com.au/rtk-vs-boundary-wire.html): Head-to-head technology comparison. Why boundary wires don't work on acreage; where RTK takes over; the consumer-GPS middle ground.
- [Robot mower vs ride-on mower](https://autoacre.com.au/autonomous-vs-ride-on.html): Service-model comparison between an autonomous mowing system and a fortnightly ride-on contractor. Cadence, 8-year economics, slope safety.
